description: This file contains the definition of the PromiseForwardGrain class, which implements the IPromiseForwardGrain interface and extends the Grain class with a specific state. It provides methods for setting and getting two integer arguments, and for retrieving their product via a related grain. The file also defines the SimpleGrainState class with serialization attributes and properties.

classes.name: SimpleGrainState
classes.description: A serializable class representing the state of the grain, with integer properties A and EventDelay.

classes.name: PromiseForwardGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing IPromiseForwardGrain, which manages simple integer state and interacts with another grain to perform operations.
